reviews.reason: The source and translation retain the complete sentence across the page boundary, including bringing their petition before the Lord of heaven. The starred wording is appropriately disclosed.
No visible word or clause is omitted. The translation preserves the inability to speak or raise their eyes, the shame, and the condemnation without supplying an unstated recipient.

The complete printed wording is retained, including the final noun አስተ and the distributive expression. The provisional rendering “extension” is explicitly qualified; apparatus note 13 correctly distinguishes witness y’s added “days” and nominative changes from the selected main text.

The source retains both occurrences of Dan, the directional expression, Armon, and the reading until sleep. The note responsibly qualifies “southwest” and distinguishes the starred critical reading from certain geographical identification.

The dream, visions, punishment, announcement, and rebuke are all represented. The source preserves the parenthesized restoration, and the footnote accurately identifies apparatus note 27 as an editorial restoration following Greek, not independent Ethiopic manuscript testimony.

The supplied location spellings match the selected printed text, including አበልስያኤል and ሴኒሴር. Gathering, weeping, the location between the named mountains, and covered faces are retained. The note appropriately discloses the starred selections and spelling variants.

The candidate includes the complete verse before XIV: recounting the visions seen in sleep, beginning the words of righteousness, and rebuking the Watchers of heaven. No visible closing clause is clipped.
